verses.arabic: الٓر ۚ تِلْكَ ءَايَـٰتُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَقُرْءَانٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
verses.english: Alif, Lam, Ra. These are the signs of the Book and a manifest Quran.
verses.transliteration_html: Aliflamra tilka ayatu alkitabi waquranin mubeenin
verses.transliteration_text: Aliflamra tilka ayatu alkitabi waquranin mubeenin

verses.arabic: رُّبَمَا يَوَدُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ مُسْلِمِينَ
verses.english: Much will the faithless wish that they had been Muslims.
verses.transliteration_html: Rubama yawaddu allatheena kafaroo law kanoo muslimeena
verses.transliteration_text: Rubama yawaddu allatheena kafaroo law kanoo muslimeena

verses.arabic: ذَرْهُمْ يَأْكُلُوا۟ وَيَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ وَيُلْهِهِمُ ٱلْأَمَلُ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.english: Leave them to eat and enjoy and to be diverted by longings. Soon they will know.
verses.transliteration_html: Tharhum yakuloo wayatamattaAAoo wayulhihimu alamalu fasawfa yaAAlamoona
verses.transliteration_text: Tharhum yakuloo wayatamattaAAoo wayulhihimu alamalu fasawfa yaAAlamoona

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا وَلَهَا كِتَابٌۭ مَّعْلُومٌۭ
verses.english: We did not destroy any town but that it had a known term.
verses.transliteration_html: Wama ahlakna min qaryatin illa walaha kitabun maAAloomun
verses.transliteration_text: Wama ahlakna min qaryatin illa walaha kitabun maAAloomun

verses.arabic: مَّا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ
verses.english: No nation can advance its time nor can it defer it.
verses.transliteration_html: Ma tasbiqu min ommatin ajalaha wama yastakhiroona
verses.transliteration_text: Ma tasbiqu min ommatin ajalaha wama yastakhiroona

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِى نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ إِنَّكَ لَمَجْنُونٌۭ
verses.english: They said, ‘O you, to whom the Reminder has been sent down, you are indeed crazy.
verses.transliteration_html: Waqaloo ya ayyuha allathee nuzzila AAalayhi alththikru innaka lamajnoonun
verses.transliteration_text: Waqaloo ya ayyuha allathee nuzzila AAalayhi alththikru innaka lamajnoonun

verses.arabic: لَّوْ مَا تَأْتِينَا بِٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
verses.english: Why do you not bring us the angels should you be truthful?!’
verses.transliteration_html: Law ma tateena bialmalaikati in kunta mina alssadiqeena
verses.transliteration_text: Law ma tateena bialmalaikati in kunta mina alssadiqeena

verses.arabic: مَا نُنَزِّلُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَمَا كَانُوٓا۟ إِذًۭا مُّنظَرِينَ
verses.english: We do not send down the angels except with due reason, and then they will not be granted any respite.
verses.transliteration_html: Ma nunazzilu almalaikata illa bialhaqqi wama kanoo ithan munthareena
verses.transliteration_text: Ma nunazzilu almalaikata illa bialhaqqi wama kanoo ithan munthareena

verses.arabic: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا ٱلذِّكْرَ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ لَحَـٰفِظُونَ
verses.english: Indeed We have sent down the Reminder, and indeed We will preserve it.
verses.transliteration_html: Inna nahnu nazzalna alththikra wainna lahu lahafithoona
verses.transliteration_text: Inna nahnu nazzalna alththikra wainna lahu lahafithoona

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ فِى شِيَعِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.english: Certainly We sent [apostles] before you to former communities,
verses.transliteration_html: Walaqad arsalna min qablika fee shiyaAAi alawwaleena
verses.transliteration_text: Walaqad arsalna min qablika fee shiyaAAi alawwaleena

verses.arabic: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verses.english: and there did not come to them any apostle but that they used to deride him.
verses.transliteration_html: Wama yateehim min rasoolin illa kanoo bihi yastahzioona
verses.transliteration_text: Wama yateehim min rasoolin illa kanoo bihi yastahzioona

verses.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ نَسْلُكُهُۥ فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
verses.english: That is how We let it pass through the hearts of the guilty:
verses.transliteration_html: Kathalika naslukuhu fee quloobi almujrimeena
verses.transliteration_text: Kathalika naslukuhu fee quloobi almujrimeena

verses.arabic: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ ۖ وَقَدْ خَلَتْ سُنَّةُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.english: they do not believe in it, and the precedent of the ancients has already passed.
verses.transliteration_html: La yuminoona bihi waqad khalat sunnatu alawwaleena
verses.transliteration_text: La yuminoona bihi waqad khalat sunnatu alawwaleena

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِم بَابًۭا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَظَلُّوا۟ فِيهِ يَعْرُجُونَ
verses.english: Were We to open for them a gate of the sky, so that they could go on ascending through it,
verses.transliteration_html: Walaw fatahna AAalayhim baban mina alssamai fathalloo feehi yaAArujoona
verses.transliteration_text: Walaw fatahna AAalayhim baban mina alssamai fathalloo feehi yaAArujoona

verses.arabic: لَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَا سُكِّرَتْ أَبْصَـٰرُنَا بَلْ نَحْنُ قَوْمٌۭ مَّسْحُورُونَ
verses.english: they would surely say, ‘Indeed a spell has been cast on our eyes; indeed, we are a bewitched lot.’
verses.transliteration_html: Laqaloo innama sukkirat absaruna bal nahnu qawmun mashooroona
verses.transliteration_text: Laqaloo innama sukkirat absaruna bal nahnu qawmun mashooroona

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ بُرُوجًۭا وَزَيَّنَّـٰهَا لِلنَّـٰظِرِينَ
verses.english: Certainly We have appointed houses in the sky and adorned them for the onlookers,
verses.transliteration_html: Walaqad jaAAalna fee alssamai buroojan wazayyannaha lilnnathireena
verses.transliteration_text: Walaqad jaAAalna fee alssamai buroojan wazayyannaha lilnnathireena

verses.arabic: وَحَفِظْنَـٰهَا مِن كُلِّ شَيْطَـٰنٍۢ رَّجِيمٍ
verses.english: and We have guarded them from every outcast Satan,
verses.transliteration_html: Wahafithnaha min kulli shaytanin rajeemin
verses.transliteration_text: Wahafithnaha min kulli shaytanin rajeemin

verses.arabic: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَرَقَ ٱلسَّمْعَ فَأَتْبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
verses.english: except someone who may eavesdrop, whereat there pursues him a manifest flame.
verses.transliteration_html: Illa mani istaraqa alssamAAa faatbaAAahu shihabun mubeenun
verses.transliteration_text: Illa mani istaraqa alssamAAa faatbaAAahu shihabun mubeenun

verses.arabic: وَٱلْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَـٰهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ مَّوْزُونٍۢ
verses.english: And We spread out the earth, and cast in it firm mountains, and We grew in it every kind of balanced thing,
verses.transliteration_html: Waalarda madadnaha waalqayna feeha rawasiya waanbatna feeha min kulli shayin mawzoonin
verses.transliteration_text: Waalarda madadnaha waalqayna feeha rawasiya waanbatna feeha min kulli shayin mawzoonin

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا لَكُمْ فِيهَا مَعَـٰيِشَ وَمَن لَّسْتُمْ لَهُۥ بِرَٰزِقِينَ
verses.english: and made in it [various] means of livelihood for you and for those whom you do not provide for.
verses.transliteration_html: WajaAAalna lakum feeha maAAayisha waman lastum lahu biraziqeena
verses.transliteration_text: WajaAAalna lakum feeha maAAayisha waman lastum lahu biraziqeena

verses.arabic: وَإِن مِّن شَىْءٍ إِلَّا عِندَنَا خَزَآئِنُهُۥ وَمَا نُنَزِّلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِقَدَرٍۢ مَّعْلُومٍۢ
verses.english: There is not a thing but that its sources are with Us, and We do not send it down except in a known measure.
verses.transliteration_html: Wain min shayin illa AAindana khazainuhu wama nunazziluhu illa biqadarin maAAloomin
verses.transliteration_text: Wain min shayin illa AAindana khazainuhu wama nunazziluhu illa biqadarin maAAloomin

verses.arabic: وَأَرْسَلْنَا ٱلرِّيَـٰحَ لَوَٰقِحَ فَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَأَسْقَيْنَـٰكُمُوهُ وَمَآ أَنتُمْ لَهُۥ بِخَـٰزِنِينَ
verses.english: And We send the fertilizing winds and send down water from the sky providing it for you to drink and you are not maintainers of its resources.
verses.transliteration_html: Waarsalna alrriyaha lawaqiha faanzalna mina alssamai maan faasqaynakumoohu wama antum lahu bikhazineena
verses.transliteration_text: Waarsalna alrriyaha lawaqiha faanzalna mina alssamai maan faasqaynakumoohu wama antum lahu bikhazineena

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَنَحْنُ ٱلْوَٰرِثُونَ
verses.english: Indeed it is We who give life and bring death and We are the inheritors.
verses.transliteration_html: Wainna lanahnu nuhyee wanumeetu wanahnu alwarithoona
verses.transliteration_text: Wainna lanahnu nuhyee wanumeetu wanahnu alwarithoona

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا ٱلْمُسْتَقْدِمِينَ مِنكُمْ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا ٱلْمُسْتَـْٔخِرِينَ
verses.english: Certainly We know the predecessors among you and certainly We know the successors,
verses.transliteration_html: Walaqad AAalimna almustaqdimeena minkum walaqad AAalimna almustakhireena
verses.transliteration_text: Walaqad AAalimna almustaqdimeena minkum walaqad AAalimna almustakhireena

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمٌۭ
verses.english: and indeed it is your Lord who will resurrect them. Indeed, He is all-wise, all-knowing.
verses.transliteration_html: Wainna rabbaka huwa yahshuruhum innahu hakeemun AAaleemun
verses.transliteration_text: Wainna rabbaka huwa yahshuruhum innahu hakeemun AAaleemun

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِن صَلْصَـٰلٍۢ مِّنْ حَمَإٍۢ مَّسْنُونٍۢ
verses.english: Certainly We created man out of a dry clay [drawn] from an aging mud,
verses.transliteration_html: Walaqad khalaqna alinsana min salsalin min hamain masnoonin
verses.transliteration_text: Walaqad khalaqna alinsana min salsalin min hamain masnoonin

verses.arabic: وَٱلْجَآنَّ خَلَقْنَـٰهُ مِن قَبْلُ مِن نَّارِ ٱلسَّمُومِ
verses.english: and We created the jinn earlier, out of a piercing fire.
verses.transliteration_html: Waaljanna khalaqnahu min qablu min nari alssamoomi
verses.transliteration_text: Waaljanna khalaqnahu min qablu min nari alssamoomi

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى خَـٰلِقٌۢ بَشَرًۭا مِّن صَلْصَـٰلٍۢ مِّنْ حَمَإٍۢ مَّسْنُونٍۢ
verses.english: When your Lord said to the angels, ‘Indeed I am going to create a human out of a dry clay [drawn] from an aging mud.
verses.transliteration_html: Waith qala rabbuka lilmalaikati innee khaliqun basharan min salsalin min hamain masnoonin
verses.transliteration_text: Waith qala rabbuka lilmalaikati innee khaliqun basharan min salsalin min hamain masnoonin

verses.arabic: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُۥ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِى فَقَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ سَـٰجِدِينَ
verses.english: So when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My spirit, then fall down in prostration before him.’
verses.transliteration_html: Faitha sawwaytuhu wanafakhtu feehi min roohee faqaAAoo lahu sajideena
verses.transliteration_text: Faitha sawwaytuhu wanafakhtu feehi min roohee faqaAAoo lahu sajideena

verses.arabic: فَسَجَدَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ
verses.english: Thereat the angels prostrated, all of them together,
verses.transliteration_html: Fasajada almalaikatu kulluhum ajmaAAoona
verses.transliteration_text: Fasajada almalaikatu kulluhum ajmaAAoona

verses.arabic: إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ أَبَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّـٰجِدِينَ
verses.english: but not Iblis: he refused to be among those who prostrated.
verses.transliteration_html: Illa ibleesa aba an yakoona maAAa alssajideena
verses.transliteration_text: Illa ibleesa aba an yakoona maAAa alssajideena

verses.arabic: قَالَ يَـٰٓإِبْلِيسُ مَا لَكَ أَلَّا تَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّـٰجِدِينَ
verses.english: He said, ‘O Iblis! What kept you from being among those who have prostrated?’
verses.transliteration_html: Qala ya ibleesu ma laka alla takoona maAAa alssajideena
verses.transliteration_text: Qala ya ibleesu ma laka alla takoona maAAa alssajideena

verses.arabic: قَالَ لَمْ أَكُن لِّأَسْجُدَ لِبَشَرٍ خَلَقْتَهُۥ مِن صَلْصَـٰلٍۢ مِّنْ حَمَإٍۢ مَّسْنُونٍۢ
verses.english: Said he, ‘I will not prostrate before a human whom You have created out of a dry clay [drawn] from an aging mud.’
verses.transliteration_html: Qala lam akun liasjuda libasharin khalaqtahu min salsalin min hamain masnoonin
verses.transliteration_text: Qala lam akun liasjuda libasharin khalaqtahu min salsalin min hamain masnoonin

verses.arabic: قَالَ فَٱخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌۭ
verses.english: He said, ‘Begone hence, for you are indeed an outcast,
verses.transliteration_html: Qala faokhruj minha fainnaka rajeemun
verses.transliteration_text: Qala faokhruj minha fainnaka rajeemun

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ ٱللَّعْنَةَ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.english: and indeed the curse shall lie on you until the Day of Retribution.’
verses.transliteration_html: Wainna AAalayka allaAAnata ila yawmi alddeeni
verses.transliteration_text: Wainna AAalayka allaAAnata ila yawmi alddeeni

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
verses.english: He said, ‘My Lord! Respite me till the day they will be resurrected.’
verses.transliteration_html: Qala rabbi faanthirnee ila yawmi yubAAathoona
verses.transliteration_text: Qala rabbi faanthirnee ila yawmi yubAAathoona

verses.arabic: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنظَرِينَ
verses.english: Said He, ‘You are indeed among the reprieved
verses.transliteration_html: Qala fainnaka mina almunthareena
verses.transliteration_text: Qala fainnaka mina almunthareena

verses.arabic: إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْوَقْتِ ٱلْمَعْلُومِ
verses.english: until the day of the known time.’
verses.transliteration_html: Ila yawmi alwaqti almaAAloomi
verses.transliteration_text: Ila yawmi alwaqti almaAAloomi

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ أَغْوَيْتَنِى لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.english: He said, ‘My Lord! As You have consigned me to perversity, I will surely glamorize [evil] for them on the earth, and I will surely pervert them, all
verses.transliteration_html: Qala rabbi bima aghwaytanee laozayyinanna lahum fee alardi walaoghwiyannahum ajmaAAeena
verses.transliteration_text: Qala rabbi bima aghwaytanee laozayyinanna lahum fee alardi walaoghwiyannahum ajmaAAeena

verses.arabic: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
verses.english: except Your dedicated servants among them.’
verses.transliteration_html: Illa AAibadaka minhumu almukhlaseena
verses.transliteration_text: Illa AAibadaka minhumu almukhlaseena

verses.arabic: قَالَ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ عَلَىَّ مُسْتَقِيمٌ
verses.english: He said, ‘This is the path [leading] straight to Me.
verses.transliteration_html: Qala hatha siratun AAalayya mustaqeemun
verses.transliteration_text: Qala hatha siratun AAalayya mustaqeemun

verses.arabic: إِنَّ عِبَادِى لَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَـٰنٌ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْغَاوِينَ
verses.english: Indeed, as for My servants you do not have any authority over them, except the perverse who follow you,
verses.transliteration_html: Inna AAibadee laysa laka AAalayhim sultanun illa mani ittabaAAaka mina alghaweena
verses.transliteration_text: Inna AAibadee laysa laka AAalayhim sultanun illa mani ittabaAAaka mina alghaweena

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمَوْعِدُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.english: and indeed hell is the tryst of them all.
verses.transliteration_html: Wainna jahannama lamawAAiduhum ajmaAAeena
verses.transliteration_text: Wainna jahannama lamawAAiduhum ajmaAAeena

verses.arabic: لَهَا سَبْعَةُ أَبْوَٰبٍۢ لِّكُلِّ بَابٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ جُزْءٌۭ مَّقْسُومٌ
verses.english: It has seven gates, and to each gate belongs a separate portion of them.’
verses.transliteration_html: Laha sabAAatu abwabin likulli babin minhum juzon maqsoomun
verses.transliteration_text: Laha sabAAatu abwabin likulli babin minhum juzon maqsoomun

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍ
verses.english: Indeed the Godwary will be amid gardens and springs.
verses.transliteration_html: Inna almuttaqeena fee jannatin waAAuyoonin
verses.transliteration_text: Inna almuttaqeena fee jannatin waAAuyoonin

verses.arabic: ٱدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَـٰمٍ ءَامِنِينَ
verses.english: ‘‘Enter it in peace and safety!’’
verses.transliteration_html: Odkhulooha bisalamin amineena
verses.transliteration_text: Odkhulooha bisalamin amineena

verses.arabic: وَنَزَعْنَا مَا فِى صُدُورِهِم مِّنْ غِلٍّ إِخْوَٰنًا عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍۢ مُّتَقَـٰبِلِينَ
verses.english: We will remove whatever rancour there is in their breasts; [intimate like] brothers, [they will be reclining] on couches, facing one another.
verses.transliteration_html: WanazaAAna ma fee sudoorihim min ghillin ikhwanan AAala sururin mutaqabileena
verses.transliteration_text: WanazaAAna ma fee sudoorihim min ghillin ikhwanan AAala sururin mutaqabileena

verses.arabic: لَا يَمَسُّهُمْ فِيهَا نَصَبٌۭ وَمَا هُم مِّنْهَا بِمُخْرَجِينَ
verses.english: Therein neither weariness shall touch them, nor will they [ever] be expelled from it.
verses.transliteration_html: La yamassuhum feeha nasabun wama hum minha bimukhrajeena
verses.transliteration_text: La yamassuhum feeha nasabun wama hum minha bimukhrajeena

verses.arabic: ۞ نَبِّئْ عِبَادِىٓ أَنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.english: Inform my servants that I am indeed the All-forgiving, the All-merciful,
verses.transliteration_html: Nabbi AAibadee annee ana alghafooru alrraheemu
verses.transliteration_text: Nabbi AAibadee annee ana alghafooru alrraheemu

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّ عَذَابِى هُوَ ٱلْعَذَابُ ٱلْأَلِيمُ
verses.english: and that My punishment is a painful punishment.
verses.transliteration_html: Wa anna AAathabee huwa alAAathabu alaleemu
verses.transliteration_text: Wa anna AAathabee huwa alAAathabu alaleemu

verses.arabic: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ عَن ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
verses.english: And inform them about the guests of Abraham,
verses.transliteration_html: Wanabbihum AAan dayfi ibraheema
verses.transliteration_text: Wanabbihum AAan dayfi ibraheema

verses.arabic: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَـٰمًۭا قَالَ إِنَّا مِنكُمْ وَجِلُونَ
verses.english: when they entered into his presence and said, ‘Peace!’ He said, ‘We are indeed afraid of you.’
verses.transliteration_html: Ith dakhaloo AAalayhi faqaloo salaman qala inna minkum wajiloona
verses.transliteration_text: Ith dakhaloo AAalayhi faqaloo salaman qala inna minkum wajiloona

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ لَا تَوْجَلْ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَـٰمٍ عَلِيمٍۢ
verses.english: They said, ‘Do not be afraid. Indeed we give you the good news of a wise son.’
verses.transliteration_html: Qaloo la tawjal inna nubashshiruka bighulamin AAaleemin
verses.transliteration_text: Qaloo la tawjal inna nubashshiruka bighulamin AAaleemin

verses.arabic: قَالَ أَبَشَّرْتُمُونِى عَلَىٰٓ أَن مَّسَّنِىَ ٱلْكِبَرُ فَبِمَ تُبَشِّرُونَ
verses.english: He said, ‘Do you give me good news though old age has befallen me? What is the good news that you bring me?’
verses.transliteration_html: Qala abashshartumoonee AAala an massaniya alkibaru fabima tubashshirooni
verses.transliteration_text: Qala abashshartumoonee AAala an massaniya alkibaru fabima tubashshirooni

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ بَشَّرْنَـٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَلَا تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْقَـٰنِطِينَ
verses.english: They said, ‘We bring you good news in truth; so do not be despondent.’
verses.transliteration_html: Qaloo bashsharnaka bialhaqqi fala takun mina alqaniteena
verses.transliteration_text: Qaloo bashsharnaka bialhaqqi fala takun mina alqaniteena

verses.arabic: قَالَ وَمَن يَقْنَطُ مِن رَّحْمَةِ رَبِّهِۦٓ إِلَّا ٱلضَّآلُّونَ
verses.english: He said, ‘Who despairs of his Lord’s mercy except the astray?!’
verses.transliteration_html: Qala waman yaqnatu min rahmati rabbihi illa alddalloona
verses.transliteration_text: Qala waman yaqnatu min rahmati rabbihi illa alddalloona

verses.arabic: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
verses.english: He said, ‘O messengers, what is now your errand?’
verses.transliteration_html: Qala fama khatbukum ayyuha almursaloona
verses.transliteration_text: Qala fama khatbukum ayyuha almursaloona

verses.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍۢ مُّجْرِمِينَ
verses.english: They said, ‘We have been sent toward a guilty people,
verses.transliteration_html: Qaloo inna orsilna ila qawmin mujrimeena
verses.transliteration_text: Qaloo inna orsilna ila qawmin mujrimeena

verses.arabic: إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ إِنَّا لَمُنَجُّوهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.english: [who shall perish] except the family of Lot. We will indeed deliver all of them,
verses.transliteration_html: Illa ala lootin inna lamunajjoohum ajmaAAeena
verses.transliteration_text: Illa ala lootin inna lamunajjoohum ajmaAAeena

verses.arabic: إِلَّا ٱمْرَأَتَهُۥ قَدَّرْنَآ ۙ إِنَّهَا لَمِنَ ٱلْغَـٰبِرِينَ
verses.english: except his wife, [who], We have ordained, will indeed be among those who remain behind.’
verses.transliteration_html: Illa imraatahu qaddarna innaha lamina alghabireena
verses.transliteration_text: Illa imraatahu qaddarna innaha lamina alghabireena

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ءَالَ لُوطٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
verses.english: So when the messengers came to Lot’s family,
verses.transliteration_html: Falamma jaa ala lootin almursaloona
verses.transliteration_text: Falamma jaa ala lootin almursaloona

verses.arabic: قَالَ إِنَّكُمْ قَوْمٌۭ مُّنكَرُونَ
verses.english: he said, ‘You are indeed strangers [to me].’
verses.transliteration_html: Qala innakum qawmun munkaroona
verses.transliteration_text: Qala innakum qawmun munkaroona

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ جِئْنَـٰكَ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَ
verses.english: They said, ‘Indeed, we bring you what they used to doubt.
verses.transliteration_html: Qaloo bal jinaka bima kanoo feehi yamtaroona
verses.transliteration_text: Qaloo bal jinaka bima kanoo feehi yamtaroona

verses.arabic: وَأَتَيْنَـٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّا لَصَـٰدِقُونَ
verses.english: We bring you the truth, and indeed, we speak truly.
verses.transliteration_html: Waataynaka bialhaqqi wainna lasadiqoona
verses.transliteration_text: Waataynaka bialhaqqi wainna lasadiqoona

verses.arabic: فَأَسْرِ بِأَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱتَّبِعْ أَدْبَـٰرَهُمْ وَلَا يَلْتَفِتْ مِنكُمْ أَحَدٌۭ وَٱمْضُوا۟ حَيْثُ تُؤْمَرُونَ
verses.english: Take your family in a watch of the night; and follow in their rear, and none of you should turn round, and proceed as you are bidden.’
verses.transliteration_html: Faasri biahlika biqitAAin mina allayli waittabiAA adbarahum wala yaltafit minkum ahadun waimdoo haythu tumaroona
verses.transliteration_text: Faasri biahlika biqitAAin mina allayli waittabiAA adbarahum wala yaltafit minkum ahadun waimdoo haythu tumaroona

verses.arabic: وَقَضَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْأَمْرَ أَنَّ دَابِرَ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ مَقْطُوعٌۭ مُّصْبِحِينَ
verses.english: We apprised him of the matter that these will be rooted out by dawn.
verses.transliteration_html: Waqadayna ilayhi thalika alamra anna dabira haolai maqtooAAun musbiheena
verses.transliteration_text: Waqadayna ilayhi thalika alamra anna dabira haolai maqtooAAun musbiheena

verses.arabic: وَجَآءَ أَهْلُ ٱلْمَدِينَةِ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ
verses.english: The people of the city came, rejoicing.
verses.transliteration_html: Wajaa ahlu almadeenati yastabshiroona
verses.transliteration_text: Wajaa ahlu almadeenati yastabshiroona

verses.arabic: قَالَ إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ ضَيْفِى فَلَا تَفْضَحُونِ
verses.english: He said, ‘These are indeed my guests. Do not bring dishonour on me.
verses.transliteration_html: Qala inna haolai dayfee fala tafdahooni
verses.transliteration_text: Qala inna haolai dayfee fala tafdahooni

verses.arabic: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَلَا تُخْزُونِ
verses.english: Be wary of Allah and do not humiliate me.’
verses.transliteration_html: Waittaqoo Allaha wala tukhzooni
verses.transliteration_text: Waittaqoo Allaha wala tukhzooni

verses.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ أَوَلَمْ نَنْهَكَ عَنِ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.english: They said, ‘Did we not forbid you from [defending ] strangers?’
verses.transliteration_html: Qaloo awalam nanhaka AAani alAAalameena
verses.transliteration_text: Qaloo awalam nanhaka AAani alAAalameena

verses.arabic: قَالَ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ بَنَاتِىٓ إِن كُنتُمْ فَـٰعِلِينَ
verses.english: He said, ‘These are my daughters, [marry them] if you should do anything.’
verses.transliteration_html: Qala haolai banatee in kuntum faAAileena
verses.transliteration_text: Qala haolai banatee in kuntum faAAileena

verses.arabic: لَعَمْرُكَ إِنَّهُمْ لَفِى سَكْرَتِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
verses.english: By your life, they were bewildered in their drunkenness.
verses.transliteration_html: LaAAamruka innahum lafee sakratihim yaAAmahoona
verses.transliteration_text: LaAAamruka innahum lafee sakratihim yaAAmahoona

verses.arabic: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُشْرِقِينَ
verses.english: So the Cry seized them at sunrise,
verses.transliteration_html: Faakhathathumu alssayhatu mushriqeena
verses.transliteration_text: Faakhathathumu alssayhatu mushriqeena

verses.arabic: فَجَعَلْنَا عَـٰلِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةًۭ مِّن سِجِّيلٍ
verses.english: and We made its topmost part its nethermost, and rained on them stones of shale.
verses.transliteration_html: FajaAAalna AAaliyaha safilaha waamtarna AAalayhim hijaratan min sijjeelin
verses.transliteration_text: FajaAAalna AAaliyaha safilaha waamtarna AAalayhim hijaratan min sijjeelin

verses.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍۢ لِّلْمُتَوَسِّمِينَ
verses.english: There are indeed signs in that for the percipient.
verses.transliteration_html: Inna fee thalika laayatin lilmutawassimeena
verses.transliteration_text: Inna fee thalika laayatin lilmutawassimeena

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّهَا لَبِسَبِيلٍۢ مُّقِيمٍ
verses.english: Indeed it is on a standing road,
verses.transliteration_html: Wainnaha labisabeelin muqeemin
verses.transliteration_text: Wainnaha labisabeelin muqeemin

verses.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةًۭ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.english: and there is indeed a sign in that for the faithful.
verses.transliteration_html: Inna fee thalika laayatan lilmumineena
verses.transliteration_text: Inna fee thalika laayatan lilmumineena

verses.arabic: وَإِن كَانَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ لَظَـٰلِمِينَ
verses.english: Indeed the inhabitants of Aykah were [also] wrongdoers.
verses.transliteration_html: Wain kana ashabu alaykati lathalimeena
verses.transliteration_text: Wain kana ashabu alaykati lathalimeena

verses.arabic: فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ وَإِنَّهُمَا لَبِإِمَامٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
verses.english: So We took vengeance on them, and indeed the two of them are on an open highway.
verses.transliteration_html: Faintaqamna minhum wainnahuma labiimamin mubeenin
verses.transliteration_text: Faintaqamna minhum wainnahuma labiimamin mubeenin

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْحِجْرِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.english: Certainly the inhabitants of Hijr denied the apostles.
verses.transliteration_html: Walaqad kaththaba ashabu alhijri almursaleena
verses.transliteration_text: Walaqad kaththaba ashabu alhijri almursaleena

verses.arabic: وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمْ ءَايَـٰتِنَا فَكَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ
verses.english: We had given them Our signs but they disregarded them.
verses.transliteration_html: Waataynahum ayatina fakanoo AAanha muAArideena
verses.transliteration_text: Waataynahum ayatina fakanoo AAanha muAArideena

verses.arabic: وَكَانُوا۟ يَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا ءَامِنِينَ
verses.english: They used to hew out dwellings from mountains feeling secure.
verses.transliteration_html: Wakanoo yanhitoona mina aljibali buyootan amineena
verses.transliteration_text: Wakanoo yanhitoona mina aljibali buyootan amineena

verses.arabic: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُصْبِحِينَ
verses.english: So the Cry seized them at dawn,
verses.transliteration_html: Faakhathathumu alssayhatu musbiheena
verses.transliteration_text: Faakhathathumu alssayhatu musbiheena

verses.arabic: فَمَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
verses.english: and what they used to earn did not avail them.
verses.transliteration_html: Fama aghna AAanhum ma kanoo yaksiboona
verses.transliteration_text: Fama aghna AAanhum ma kanoo yaksiboona

verses.arabic: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ ۗ وَإِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ لَـَٔاتِيَةٌۭ ۖ فَٱصْفَحِ ٱلصَّفْحَ ٱلْجَمِيلَ
verses.english: We did not create the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them except with consummate wisdom, and indeed the Hour is bound to come. So forbear with a graceful forbearance.
verses.transliteration_html: Wama khalaqna alssamawati waalarda wama baynahuma illa bialhaqqi wainna alssaAAata laatiyatun faisfahi alssafha aljameela
verses.transliteration_text: Wama khalaqna alssamawati waalarda wama baynahuma illa bialhaqqi wainna alssaAAata laatiyatun faisfahi alssafha aljameela

verses.arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ ٱلْخَلَّـٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.english: Indeed your Lord is the All-creator, the All-knowing.
verses.transliteration_html: Inna rabbaka huwa alkhallaqu alAAaleemu
verses.transliteration_text: Inna rabbaka huwa alkhallaqu alAAaleemu

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَـٰكَ سَبْعًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْمَثَانِى وَٱلْقُرْءَانَ ٱلْعَظِيمَ
verses.english: Certainly We have given you [the surah of] the seven oft-repeated verses and the great Quran.
verses.transliteration_html: Walaqad ataynaka sabAAan mina almathanee waalqurana alAAatheema
verses.transliteration_text: Walaqad ataynaka sabAAan mina almathanee waalqurana alAAatheema

verses.arabic: لَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ إِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجًۭا مِّنْهُمْ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.english: Do not extend your glance toward what We have provided to certain groups of them, and do not grieve for them, and lower your wing to the faithful,
verses.transliteration_html: La tamuddanna AAaynayka ila ma mattaAAna bihi azwajan minhum wala tahzan AAalayhim waikhfid janahaka lilmumineena
verses.transliteration_text: La tamuddanna AAaynayka ila ma mattaAAna bihi azwajan minhum wala tahzan AAalayhim waikhfid janahaka lilmumineena

verses.arabic: وَقُلْ إِنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱلنَّذِيرُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
verses.english: and say, ‘I am indeed a manifest warner [of punishment from God],’
verses.transliteration_html: Waqul innee ana alnnatheeru almubeenu
verses.transliteration_text: Waqul innee ana alnnatheeru almubeenu

verses.arabic: كَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَى ٱلْمُقْتَسِمِينَ
verses.english: like that We sent down upon those who split into bands,
verses.transliteration_html: Kama anzalna AAala almuqtasimeena
verses.transliteration_text: Kama anzalna AAala almuqtasimeena

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ جَعَلُوا۟ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ عِضِينَ
verses.english: who represented the Quran as magic.
verses.transliteration_html: Allatheena jaAAaloo alqurana AAideena
verses.transliteration_text: Allatheena jaAAaloo alqurana AAideena

verses.arabic: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَسْـَٔلَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.english: By your Lord, We will question them all
verses.transliteration_html: Fawarabbika lanasalannahum ajmaAAeena
verses.transliteration_text: Fawarabbika lanasalannahum ajmaAAeena

verses.arabic: عَمَّا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.english: concerning what they used to do.
verses.transliteration_html: AAamma kanoo yaAAmaloona
verses.transliteration_text: AAamma kanoo yaAAmaloona

verses.arabic: فَٱصْدَعْ بِمَا تُؤْمَرُ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
verses.english: So proclaim what you have been commanded, and turn away from the polytheists.
verses.transliteration_html: FaisdaAA bima tumaru waaAArid AAani almushrikeena
verses.transliteration_text: FaisdaAA bima tumaru waaAArid AAani almushrikeena

verses.arabic: إِنَّا كَفَيْنَـٰكَ ٱلْمُسْتَهْزِءِينَ
verses.english: Indeed We will suffice you against the deriders
verses.transliteration_html: Inna kafaynaka almustahzieena
verses.transliteration_text: Inna kafaynaka almustahzieena

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْعَلُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ ۚ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.english: —those who set up another deity besides Allah. Soon they will know!
verses.transliteration_html: Allatheena yajAAaloona maAAa Allahi ilahan akhara fasawfa yaAAlamoona
verses.transliteration_text: Allatheena yajAAaloona maAAa Allahi ilahan akhara fasawfa yaAAlamoona

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ نَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ يَضِيقُ صَدْرُكَ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ
verses.english: Certainly We know that you become upset because of what they say.
verses.transliteration_html: Walaqad naAAlamu annaka yadeequ sadruka bima yaqooloona
verses.transliteration_text: Walaqad naAAlamu annaka yadeequ sadruka bima yaqooloona

verses.arabic: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَكُن مِّنَ ٱلسَّـٰجِدِينَ
verses.english: So celebrate the praise of your Lord and be among those who prostrate,
verses.transliteration_html: Fasabbih bihamdi rabbika wakun mina alssajideena
verses.transliteration_text: Fasabbih bihamdi rabbika wakun mina alssajideena

verses.arabic: وَٱعْبُدْ رَبَّكَ حَتَّىٰ يَأْتِيَكَ ٱلْيَقِينُ
verses.english: and worship your Lord until certainty comes to you.
verses.transliteration_html: WaoAAbud rabbaka hatta yatiyaka alyaqeenu
verses.transliteration_text: WaoAAbud rabbaka hatta yatiyaka alyaqeenu
